resourceProfile.assessment: Selected Hindi after independent comparison of 16 common semantic IDs across all 24 target locales and focused checks of weaker candidates. Hindi combined wrong-sense technical labels, malformed instructions and a reversed battery pulse-rating warning. Full independent review covered 1115 canonical entries, 11 route records, glossary, eight optional fallbacks and six catalog nouns. Canonical English, effective-runtime extraction, Hindi glossary, calling UI and knowledge-base articles supplied context. NCERT thermal terminology was available through IIT Kanpur SATHEE.
limitations: Selection is comparative screening, not an exhaustive global quality ranking.
Model review is not competent human language review or maintainer approval.
English source defects are documented separately; canonical English and other locales are unchanged.
Dynamic entity research prose outside canonical dictionary was not represented in the provided runtime extraction.
TI landing page was retrieved but its video transcript was unavailable; battery edits preserve existing canonical claims without new safety advice.
Juice mobile overflow from existing off-screen sr-only input positioning also reproduces unchanged in English; no unrelated layout change made.
